title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test / Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test-2
objectives: Test whether a modified P-Trak particle counter can measure aerosol particles accurately in microgravity and confirm that it is reliable enough for the SAME experiments, since the stock instrument was not expected to work reliably without gravity.
approach: The modified P-Trak was operated in microgravity and its readings were compared with a DustTrak reference instrument, using different aerosol samples and standards.
